entries.desc: The roadmap states the current implementation baseline for scope, owner, parallel work, and baseline surfaces, marking what is already implemented versus future work.

evidence.note: The repaired roadmap contains a current implementation status axis and classifies shipped/harden-existing/current surfaces.

entries.desc: Each baseline surface is mapped to its source of truth, including Authority receipt, lifecycle receipt consumption, lifecycle artifact scope, story lifecycle, session ownership, and parallel wave documents where applicable.

evidence.note: Source mapping now includes direct Authority receipt and lifecycle receipt sources plus the existing lifecycle/session/parallel sources.

entries.desc: The repaired docs must not describe existing scope, owner, parallel, baseline, Authority receipt, or lifecycle receipt behavior as merely planned future work.

evidence.command: git show --name-only --format= HEAD && rg -n "not describe owner lease|rather than inventing scope freeze|not let local evidence set Authority completion" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
evidence.note: Commit changed only the roadmap document and the new wording prevents existing scope/owner/parallel/receipt surfaces from being treated as net-new future work.

entries.desc: The related roadmap documents define the three-round by two-host escalation predicate mechanically, with named inputs, decision table or equivalent truth conditions, outputs, and the exact escalation/no-escalation result.

evidence.note: The roadmap now states the mechanical 3x2 predicate and separates threshold-triggered escalation from explicit high-risk policy opt-in.

entries.desc: Local verdict signature and verifiability requirements are documented with signer, signed fields, freshness/hash expectations, and invalid/stale signature handling.

evidence.note: Local counted verdict requirements now name identity/freshness bindings and signed or registry-backed provenance instead of accepting transcript/prose.

entries.desc: Validation cannot remain prose-only: each relevant milestone lists minimal validation commands plus expected artifacts, artifact ids, or roadmap row ids that evidence the 3x2 predicate and verdict signature behavior.

evidence.command: rg -n "review_escalation_status|autopilot_review_status|decision_doc_quorum_check|lattice validate --story|npm --prefix packages/main run build" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md && git diff --check HEAD^..HEAD && npm --prefix packages/main run build
evidence.note: M6/M8/M12 validation sections list concrete commands/artifact rows; diff check and TypeScript build passed for the repaired tree.

entries.desc: The roadmap contains a milestone-to-rollout crosswalk that binds each affected milestone to rollout stage, policy version, enforcement mode, and expected operator-visible artifact or command evidence.

evidence.note: The roadmap now contains a milestone-to-rollout crosswalk with policy version, enforcement mode, in-flight treatment, and operator-visible evidence columns.

entries.desc: In-flight story treatment, false-positive rollback or de-escalation, and recovery controls are documented for stories already past PLAN/DEV/REVIEW when the rollout policy changes.

evidence.command: rg -n "in-flight|false-positive|de-escalation|prior accepted policy version|do not reopen" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
evidence.note: The repaired rollout section documents in-flight treatment and false-positive rollback/de-escalation without reopening DONE stories.

entries.desc: The self-hosting emergency bypass is tightly scoped, auditable, time-bounded or version-bounded, and cannot silently bypass policy/version gates or permanent blocker semantics.

evidence.command: rg -n "M11 staged runbook|Audited emergency bypass|expiry by time|policyVersion|must not bypass git cleanliness|cannot set `authorityDone`" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
evidence.note: The emergency bypass is explicitly audited, scoped to self-hosting over-block, time/policy bounded, and barred from setting Authority, DONE, full 3x2, or baseline PASS claims.
